description: Pocket Option DEMO bot for Firefox on Android. Intercepts the page's own auth message (or reads the session cookie) in-memory only, opens its own Socket.IO price socket, and trades CALL/PUT on the demo account only. No SSID pasted in chat, no external price source. Demo only — automation violates Pocket Option's terms and can get the account banned even on demo. No profit guarantee.
name: Pocket Demo Bot — Firefox Extension
